    performance_tier,

    COUNT(*) as count
FROM lever__hiring_manager_scorecard
WHERE performance_tier IS NOT NULL 
    AND hiring_specialization IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY performance_tier, hiring_specialization
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY performance_tier, hiring_specialization
"""

    cursor = conn.execute(query)
    results = cursor.fetchall()

        print("No results meeting minimum bucket size of 10")

        # Organize results into a structured table
        contingency_data = {}
        all_tiers = set()
        all_specializations = set()

            all_tiers.add(tier)
            all_specializations.add(specialization)
            if tier not in contingency_data:
                contingency_data[tier] = {}
            contingency_data[tier][specialization] = count
        
        # Sort the categories for consistent display
        sorted_tiers = sorted(all_tiers)
        sorted_specializations = sorted(all_specializations)

            header += f" | {spec}"

            for spec in sorted_specializations:

        print("\nSummary:")
